note: The catalog rules whose runtime materialization R7-B.1 changed, with the consumers and tests R7-B.1 adds to the base entries (which keep theirs). The R7-B engineering recheck found B0-C06#c8, B0-C07#c1 and B0-C08#c1 contradicted on the QE-R7B-R2-01 and -R2-03 paths; these entries record what now materializes them. An id outside the base matrix is an R7-A invariant the change touches. Revision 2 (the one correction cycle after the reviews of R7B1-FREEZE-1, request §17) adds what materializes the cycle's fixes: the clinical screen before any block-choice question (QE-R7B1-01, B0-C06#c8 and R7A:A5), the no-lower-skill question that acts (QR7B1-01, B0-C07#c1), the event-week rule for every row whatever placed it, its disclosure and the program-end wording (QR7B1-02, -04, -05; R7B1-SSCTR-F11 and the review half of F12; B0-C05#c1), the rotation slots and the exhaustion question (QR7B1-02, -03; B0-C06#c8).
